time_convention: t = frame / 25; frame = round(t * 25); frame 0 is t = 0
pixel_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left, full-resolution pixels

camera.motion: static (phase correlation on the rock region, every 3rd frame: shift < 0.03 px all clip)
camera.view: high oblique aerial view looking down on a sandy beach with a raised white rock plateau (top) and green sea (bottom); no horizon or sky visible
camera.perspective_cues: ground (sand) plane fills y~0-530; sea from y~530 down; no usable vanishing points; scene far from camera so perspective across the bird's path is weak (bird apparent size roughly constant)

objects.name: bird
objects.description: the only animal: a dark brown bird (eagle/hawk-like) flying left-to-right across the upper part of the frame, flapping its wings
objects.reference_point: centroid of dark mask (proxy for the body/origin)
objects.apparent_size_px: bbox_h 19-40, bbox_w 25-43 depending on wing phase; flap-cycle maxima of bbox_h ~37 (f0-1), ~40 (f25), ~39 (f49-50): no clear size trend -> roughly constant depth
objects.notes: f37-45 over dark brown rock: mask weaker (low_contrast=1). f52-54 partly outside frame (edge_clipped=1). Not visible f55-74.

objects.name: bird_shadow
objects.description: the bird's shadow on the sand: grey-blue two-winged silhouette ~300 px right and 130-145 px below the bird; shape changes in phase with the wing beats
objects.path_px: x 376 -> 892, y 358 -> 393; disappears at f34 near the beach/sea edge around (900,393)
objects.notes: NOT a second bird; it is a shadow (its length oscillates in sync with the bird's flapping). Shadow offset from bird: (dx,dy) = (317,135) at f0, (303,146) at f25

objects.name: rock_plateau
objects.description: large raised white/snowy rock mass with brown eroded cliffs on its right and lower edges, top-centre/right of image
objects.notes: continues to right image edge; striped brown cliff base along y~285-310 for x~560-800

objects.name: sand_beach
objects.description: pale pink sand plain around the rock, ground plane
objects.notes: wet-sand / shallow band between beach edge and green water, edge hazy

objects.name: sea
objects.description: green-turquoise water with moving wave texture, lower ~45% of frame

events.event: bird already flying at clip start
bird wing-beat: mask area minima (wings edge-on) approx
bird wing-beat: mask area maxima approx
bird slight vertical (image y) undulation: local y max
bird crosses over the rock plateau
bird reaches right image edge / exits
